_comment: Scenario A — Healthy transformer: all parameters well within limits
scenario_notes: Low TCG (~168 ppm), no ratio anomalies, cold oil, near-zero C2H2.

_comment: Scenario B — Thermal degradation: hot-spot overheating of oil/winding
scenario_notes: C2H4/C2H6 ~1.89 (>1.0 thermal threshold). CH4/H2 ~1.58 (>1 supports thermal, not discharge). Elevated temperature. TCG ~549 ppm (MEDIUM severity).

_comment: Scenario C — Partial discharge: hydrogen-rich corona in insulation voids
scenario_notes: CH4/H2 ~0.16 (<0.2 discharge threshold). H2 dominant at 340 ppm. C2H2/C2H4 ~0.021 (very low, rules out arcing). Elevated PD at 680 pC.

_comment: Scenario D — Arcing / severe fault: high-energy electrical discharge
scenario_notes: C2H2/C2H4 ~0.437 (>0.3 critical arcing threshold). C2H2/CH4 ~0.321 (strong arcing confirmation). C2H2 at 38.5 ppm >> critical threshold. TCG ~992 ppm. Very poor health expected.

_comment: Scenario E — Borderline warning: mixed signals, no single dominant fault
scenario_notes: C2H4/C2H6 ~1.14 (modest thermal signal). CH4/H2 ~0.56 (not clearly discharge). C2H2 at 1.8 ppm just below high arcing threshold. Temperature elevated but not critical. Mixed picture — borderline case.
